info.name: Library SOAP API
info.description:
SOAP 1.2 API for the library (document/literal).

Every operation is a POST to {{baseUrl}} with:
- Content-Type: application/soap+xml; charset=utf-8; action="<namespace>/<Operation>"
  (SOAP 1.2 has no separate SOAPAction header; the action is a parameter of the Content-Type)
- Accept: application/soap+xml
- A SOAP envelope in the body

Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner. The requests are ordered:
happy path creates a publishing company, an author and a book and stores their ids in collection variables,
the negative tests use those ids, and the cleanup folder deletes everything again.
